report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Sullivan Mutual Water, CA4300571

sources_described: The water system is served by one (1) groundwater well located off Lantz Road.
search_log: WebSearch "Green Acres Mutual Water" OR "Sullivan Mutual Water" Morgan Hill water quality report -> only aggregator listings and the City of Morgan Hill CCR (different system); no report for Sullivan

extraction_notes: Text PDF; pages verified from pdftotext form feeds (Tables 1-2 on page 3, Table 3 on page 4, Tables 3A and 4 on page 5). Fluoride unit is printed as µg/L (almost certainly mg/L). Perchlorate and chlorine 'Level Detected' values are printed in parentheses, which the column header defines as averages. The report has no coliform table, no unregulated-contaminant table and no violation table; nothing is asterisked.
